function warmUpShaders(renderer, s): Promise<void>

Defined in: experiments/earth-playground/earth/setup/bootstrap.ts:33

Pre-compiles the scene's shader programs so the first visible frame doesn't hitch on JIT. compileAsync failures (driver hiccups, lost device) are non-fatal — the renderer recompiles lazily on first draw.
